concerns.text: Task T021 mandates loading 'bigcode/starcoder2-3b' for CPU inference. However, the Plan (Summary & Technical Context) and Spec (FR-004) explicitly define the primary CPU target as 'StarCoder2-1.5B' (with 3B as a GPU fallback only). This task contradicts the approved plan, creating a high risk of OOM failure on the CI runner and failing to satisfy the CPU constraint defined in FR-004.

Tasks T038 (ECE Implementation) and T029 (ECE Test) implement Expected Calibration Error calculation. This functionality is absent from the Spec (FR-001 through FR-013) and the Plan. The tasks cite a 'simulated Daniel Kahneman review' as justification, but no such requirement exists in the current FR/SC set. This is unapproved scope creep; the implementer cannot satisfy a spec requirement that does not exist.

Task T034 hardcodes the sensitivity analysis thresholds as {0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99}. While FR-013 and SC-005 mention this set, FR-009 (the primary sensitivity requirement) defines the scope as '{high, very high}' without explicit numeric values. The task assumes a specific numeric set not explicitly authorized in the primary requirement text, creating a potential mismatch if the plan intended a different set for the 'high-confidence' sweep.

Task T021 requires capturing 'avg_confidence' (token probabilities) for ECE calculation. The Spec (FR-004) and Plan only mandate capturing pass/fail results and enforcing timeouts. There is no functional requirement in the spec to log confidence scores. This is a writing-level disconnect where the task adds a data-capture requirement not present in the source spec.
